question: What are the duration of the longest and shortest pop tracks in milliseconds?
failed_sql: SELECT T1.TAR, T2.TAR FROM TRACK AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.TAR  =  T2.TAR ORDER BY T1.TAR DESC LIMIT 1 ,  ORDER BY T1.TAR ASC LIMIT 1
teacher_sql:
SELECT T1.Milliseconds
FROM TRACK AS T1
JOIN GENRE AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId
WHERE T2.Name = 'Pop'
ORDER BY T1.Milliseconds DESC
UNION QUALLY
SELECT T1.Milliseconds
FROM TRACK AS T1
JOIN GENRE AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId
WHERE T2.Name = 'Pop'
ORDER BY T1.Milliseconds ASC

question: What is the department name of the students with lowest gpa belongs to?

teacher_sql: SELECT DEPARTMENT.DEPT_NAME FROM STUDENT JOIN DEPARTMENT ON STUDENT.DEPT_CODE = DEPARTMENT.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY STUDENT.STU_GPA ASC LIMIT 1

question: list in alphabetic order all course names and their instructors' names in year 2008.
failed_sql: SELECT t1.title , instructor.name FROM course AS t1 JOIN instructor AS t2 ON t1.dept_name  =  t2.dept_name WHERE t1.year  =  2008 ORDER BY t1.title , t2.name
teacher_sql:
SELECT c.title, i.name
FROM course AS c
JOIN section AS s ON c.course_id = s.course_id
JOIN teaches AS t ON s.course_id = t.course_id AND s.sec_id = t.sec_id AND s.semester = t.semester AND s.year = t.year
JOIN instructor AS i ON t.ID = i.ID
WHERE s.year = 2008
ORDER BY c.title, i.name

question: How many routes go from the United States to Canada?
failed_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM routes WHERE dst_ap  =  'Canada' AND country  =  'United States'
teacher_sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM routes r
JOIN airports src ON r.src_apid = src.apid
JOIN airports dst ON r.dst_apid = dst.apid
WHERE src.country = 'United States' AND dst.country = 'Canada'

question: What is the id and last name of the driver who participated in the most races after 2010?
failed_sql: SELECT driverId ,  surname FROM drivers ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
teacher_sql: SELECT driverId, surname FROM drivers JOIN results ON drivers.driverId = results.driverId JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId WHERE races.year > 2010 GROUP BY driverId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
